After the Version 3.0 update, drive cars in Cicia, cruising through the city and the wilderness.
>> Visit car rental shops across Cicia and talk to the staff to rent a car with Ingride d'Or. Rent up to one car at a time, and rented cars can only be driven within Cicia.
>> While driving, use Jump to clear obstacles and rough terrain. Keep turning at high speed to trigger Drift, which builds energy for Boost to accelerate.
>> The car has a built-in radio. Switch radio channels or play your collected Gramophone Records.
>> If your current outfit is unsuitable for driving when you enter the car, it automatically changes to a driving-friendly outfit. You can also set the styling that auto-changes when driving.
● Added Unbound Pass: Twilight Chanson

After the Version 3.0 update, reach Pride of Cicia, Stage 5 in the Arts Prestige Handbook and spend 200,000 Ingride d'Or to obtain the Unbound Pass: Twilight Chanson. Use it to summon the Twilight Chanson, a car two stylists can ride together, anytime and anywhere.
>> The Twilight Chanson car can travel across Miraland.
>> While driving the Twilight Chanson, use Toggle Roof to switch between open-top and roofed states.
■ Douce the Cadenceborn Now Available

After the Version 3.0 update, teleport to the Warp Spire at the Fleurval East Riverbank, find Douce the Cadenceborn, collect Dew of Inspiration, and complete the world quest "Encounter Douce the Cadenceborn." Exchange Dew of Inspiration for the 4-star outfit sketch "Sprinkles of Dream," the 4-star Ability Outfit sketch "Morning Song's Spring," and the sketches for "Momo's Cloak: Bib" and "Momo's Cloak: Snowfall."

>> Complete the 4-star outfit "Morning Song's Spring" to unlock the "Default: Harmonica" ability. After using the ability, tap or hold different notes to let inspiration flow naturally and play a vibrant melody on the harmonica.
■ Mira Crown Styling Contest Update
After the Version 3.0 update, the Mira Crown Styling Contest adds Mira Crown Styling Contest: Cicia, with 15 challenges that do not reset or change over time.

>> Unlock requirement: reach Level 25 or defeat the Sovereign of the Cicia Styling Factions, progress through the Cicia main quests to reach the Cicia Stylist's Guild, then talk to Elius to unlock. Stylists who have unlocked the Mira Crown Styling Contest in other areas unlock Mira Crown Styling Contest: Cicia directly once the conditions are met.

>> Complete styling challenges to earn star ratings, and claim Diamonds, Sparklites, clothing pieces, and more based on your stars. Clearing Mira Crown Styling Contest: Cicia grants the 5-star earrings "Splendid Crystal Glow," the 5-star handheld "Glory of Valor," and the 5-star pendant "Glory Sash."
■ Mira Crown Merit Arena Update

After the Version 3.0 update, the Mira Crown Merit Arena adds a Cicia area and opens the new contest theme "The Shore of Reunion" on December 10 at 13:00 (UTC-7). Stylists can switch between the Itzaland and Cicia areas in the area tabs at the top of the Merit Arena interface and enter any open contest theme.
From December 11, 04:00 (Server Time) until January 5, 2027, 12:49 (UTC-7), take part in the Mira Crown Merit Arena limited-time event to earn Diamonds.
● Arena Setup
The "The Shore of Reunion" theme has 30 arenas, each with a single round. Clear the current arena to challenge the next. Some later arenas are Peril arenas with greater difficulty.

>> Each arena sets 1 – 3 objectives. The number of objectives met determines the Starlight earned, up to 3 stars per arena. Stylists can retry the same arena; objectives met in each attempt are recorded by the Infinity Mirror, so you can complete them gradually across multiple attempts.
>> Entering an arena automatically activates the Cycle Buff and Arena Buff. The Cycle Buff applies to all arenas in the current theme, while the Arena Buff is each arena's exclusive effect.
● How to Unlock

Completing the world quest "Mira Crown Styling Contest: Cicia" automatically accepts the world quest "Mira Crown Merit Arena: Cicia." Talk to Elius on the second floor of the Cicia Stylist's Guild to begin.
● Event Access
Enter by talking to Elius on the second floor of the Cicia Stylist's Guild, or via the Mira Crown button in Pear-Pal, then switch to the Cicia region in the Merit Arena interface.
● Event Rewards
>> Clearing an arena for the first time grants a first-clear reward, once per arena.

>> When your accumulated Starlight reaches the designated amount, claim the Starlight Rewards, which include the musket "Golden Verse," the staff "Cascading Tribute," Diamonds, growth materials, and more.

Note: The Merit Arena has no time limit and stays open permanently once launched. The Cicia region has no exchange shop, and Starlight has no weekly earn cap. Weapons and Battle Setup cannot be changed after entering an arena.
● Added Co-op Battle Feature
>> On the Merit Arena stage-select screen, use the Invite button to invite other stylists to team up. Only the inviting stylist can change the arena, choosing from arenas both have unlocked.
>> After teaming up, tap Battle Prep on the stage-select screen to adjust Nikki's and Momo's Battle Setup. After a successful challenge, both stylists earn clear rewards.
■ Whim Calendar Update
● Daily Wishes
After the Version 3.0 update, daily Surprise Tasks can refresh with Cicia area tasks. Complete Daily Wishes to claim Diamonds, growth materials, and more.
● Realm Challenge

After the Version 3.0 update, new Cicia Realms will be added to the Realm of The Dark, Realm of Eureka, and Realm of Breakthrough. Complete these realm challenges to earn new crafting materials, Glow-Up materials, evolution materials, Eurekas, and more.
>> Realm of The Dark
Added the Phantom Trial: Artshift Tide realms. Complete challenges to earn new crafting materials.
Added the Phantom Trial: Artblight Shade realms. Complete challenges to earn new Glow-Up materials.
>> Realm of Breakthrough
Added the realm the Hollow of Creation. Complete the challenge to earn the new 4-star evolution material "Unclouded Thoughts" and 5-star evolution material "Artful Thoughts."
>> Realm of Eureka
Added the realm "The Ideal City" Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the new 5-star Eurekas "Dreamlight Pieces" and "Only Dawnlight."
● New Area-Specific Gameplay Features

After the Version 3.0 update, the Whim Calendar adds Cicia and Itzaland tabs showing each area's signature features. Stylists can locate gameplay faster or collect rewards quickly. An area tab appears once any signature feature in that area is unlocked.
>> The Cicia tab shows the Arts Prestige Handbook, Great Alchemist's Guide, "Maestro" Intel Board, "Veiled Truths" Divination, and Warmhearted Boutique.
>> The Itzaland tab shows the Hotpot House, Behemoth Guardian Project, Expansion, and Soft Fragrance.
■ Home System Update
● Added Bacélien's Home Collection Store

After the Version 3.0 update, Bacélien's Home Collection store opens on Barge Street in Cicia City. Once your Construction Ability reaches Level 2, spend Ingride d'Or to buy furniture previously obtained for free.

>> Available furniture includes furniture already obtained from quests or open-world gameplay, furniture made from sketches in the Yardling Shop and Decor Catalog, and furniture obtained through other Home gameplay. It excludes furniture obtained by signing the Dreamland Pact and furniture bought with Dreamland Stones in the Dreamland Store.
>> The store refreshes Premium Furniture and Standard Furniture daily, with random discounts.
>> Use targeted selection to choose the furniture you want; it arrives in 5 days and can then be purchased. Reserve up to 1 Premium Furniture and 2 Standard Furniture at a time.
>> When purchasing, you can also choose Gift to a Friend. After a successful gift, your friend receives the gift box at the Gift Wrapping Table in their Home.
>> Bacélien's Home Collection store sells furniture only, not the furniture sketches.

>> Some furniture obtained from quests or open-world gameplay only appears in Bacélien's Home Collection store refreshes and targeted selection after you have obtained it once from the quest or gameplay feature.
● New Open-World Resources

After the Version 3.0 update, Toast Floof, Curly-Eared Pursel, Star Alpaca, Night Baron, Tuxedo Cat, Mattebunny, Captain Seagull, Sailor Turtle, and Garden Platypus can be invited to your Home with the Animal Inviting ability. Kroma Rose, Lace Iris, Rosombrelle, Goldzest Citron Tree, Brioche Plane Tree, Ruffleveil Iris, Everdew Sage, Fountain of Color, Mirubo, and Silvercrown Pine can be planted in your Home with the Planting ability. Jewel Fish, Star Sturgeon, Glimdart Fish, Stone-Eyed Fish, and Plaid Eel can be raised in your Home with the Fish Keeping ability.

>> Added exclusive decorations for Star Alpaca and Sailor Turtle: "Gleaming Night Bow" and "Shells and Sails Hat." Reach max Animal Affection for a certain animal to obtain its exclusive decoration sketch. Craft it at the Home Crafting Table, then talk to the animal in your Home and choose to modify its appearance to equip it.
● Decor Catalog Update
After the Version 3.0 update, the Yardling Shop adds Cicia Volume 1 and Cicia Volume 2. After purchasing them, photographing furniture in the Cicia area and dungeons grants furniture sketches.
● Gramophone Feature Update
>> Added Repeat One, Repeat All, and Shuffle play modes. Adjust the Gramophone volume separately, and the interface now shows record duration.
>> Added a Gramophone player for quick pause, track skipping, and play mode switching.
>> Added custom playlists. Create up to 3 playlists, each holding up to 20 records, with editable playlist names.
>> On the album or playlist screen of the Home Gramophone, select Set as Now Playing to set it as the playlist playing in your Home.

>> When exchanging Gramophone Records with Alison, the Cadenceborn, or the record collectors in Firework Isles, Serenity Island, Danqing Island, and Wanxiang Realm, select a record to preview it. Obtaining a single Gramophone Record also auto-plays its preview music.
■ Momo Growth Update
● Momo Enhancement

After the Version 3.0 update, the Basic Insight interface is improved, and the upgrade caps for Health and ATK are raised. A new Cicia Insight page is added; activating its nodes unlocks Special Attacks.
● Cloak Enhancement
After the Version 3.0 update, Momo's Cloak Enhancement upgrades by Combat Set, and some cloaks raise both basic attack and Special Attack.
■ Starlit Pursuit Update
After the Version 3.0 update, the Starlit Pursuit event includes starlit trails in the Cicia area. Collect Starlit Crystals to exchange for clothing, poses, and more in the Starlit Shop.
■ Courses Update

After the Version 3.0 update, Courses adds Cicia area achievements. Reach the goals to claim the sketches "Momo's Cloak: Harmony," "Momo's Cloak: Rogue," "Momo's Cloak: Star Leap," and "Momo's Cloak: Gem Magic," the item Heartshine: For You Who Have Waited, the title "Cicia Riddle Master," and more. Completing Advanced Courses also grants achievement rank badges such as "Newcomer to the Arts."
■ Pear-Pal Update
● Whim Moment Now Available
After the Version 3.0 update, the profile area in Pear-Pal adds the Whim Moment feature, where you can change your Starlit Shadow and Snapshot Hourglass, with preview, switching, and saving.
>> Starlit Shadows: These are projections of Nikki from parallel worlds within the Sea of Stars. Illuminate them to unlock infinite possibilities.
>> Snapshot Hourglass: Look into the Snapshot Hourglass to revisit images left by other stylists.

After the Version 3.0 update, all stylists receive the initial Starlit Shadow and Snapshot Hourglass by default, with no manual claim needed. More Starlit Shadows and Snapshot Hourglasses can be obtained later through Treasured Journey and other means.
● Early Access Now Available
After the Version 3.0 update, Pear-Pal adds Early Access, letting stylists unlock certain features ahead of story progression.
>> Features available for early unlock include Momo Combat, Momo Growth, and the abilities Default: Animal-Grooming, Default: Bug-Catching, and Default: Fishing.
>> Select the content and the Unlock Now button to unlock it early. Select Standard Unlock to view the original unlock method.
>> Early unlock does not affect later quests or story experience. After unlocking, go directly from Early Access to the Tutorials to review them anytime.
■ Capture the Moment Photography Studio Now Open
After the Version 3.0 update, the Capture the Moment Photography Studio officially opens in Cicia. Stylists can take ID photos and sticker photos here and exchange them for new photo poses.
● ID Photos
>> While progressing Cicia-related quests, you can take the ID photos required for Nikki's and Momo's student IDs and the City Navigator License.
>> Visit the Capture the Moment Photography Studio and talk to the photographer Visset to take exclusive ID photos for Nikki or Momo at any time. The photos will be saved to Nikki's Album.
● Sticker Photos

>> Visit the Capture the Moment Photography Studio and talk to the photographer Thibert or Léonie to take duo sticker photos of Nikki and Momo. Each photographer has exclusive sticker photo poses. Put on your favorite styling and capture fun photos with Momo!
● Photo Pose Exchange
>> Talk to the photographers Thibert and Léonie to exchange for the sticker photo poses "Momo's Here," "Momo's Beat," "Hey, Us!" and "Momo Hunt";
>> The exchanged poses can be used in Momo's Camera > Framed Moment.
■ Marques Boutique Cicia Branch Now Open
After the Version 3.0 update, the century-old Marques Boutique opens a branch, Marques Boutique Cicia Branch, in Caecilia Square in Cicia. Stylists can visit to shop for new clothing pieces.

>> The store carries its signature 5-star dress "Splendid Cut," the 4-star earrings "Rich Choco Heart," headwear "Garden Morning Rite," neckwear "Tidal Dream," socks "Enchanted Night Trick," and backpiece "Pink-Toned Reverie," plus 3-star pieces such as the dress "Indigo Petal Note" and the shoes "Mill Waltz."
■ Surprise-O-Matic

After the Version 3.0 update, the Cicia-exclusive Surprise-O-Matic opens. Spend Blings to obtain exquisite clothing pieces, including the 5-star dresses "Poem of Stillness," "Thorned Springlight," "Half-Hidden Fragrance," and "Blues' End," the 5-star bottom "First Smile," the 5-star chest accessory "Falling Renown," the 5-star neckwear "Silver Pearl Pilgrimage," the 5-star pendant "Cool-Toned Collection," the 4-star headwear "Endless Fairytale" and "Mystic Lamp's Call," the 4-star outerwear "Catchy Stripes," the 3-star shoes "A Drop of Blue Rain," the 3-star headwear "Dreamsea Legend," and the 3-star choker "Echoes of Night."
Note: When you first approach a Surprise-O-Matic in Cicia, you can accept the random quest "Surprises Never Stop!" The first draw is free.
■ Compendium / Expeditions / Scrapbook / Folklore Guide Updates
After the Version 3.0 update, the Compendium, Expeditions, Scrapbook, and Folklore Guide will add Cicia region content. Complete collections to earn Diamonds and other rewards.
★ Optimizations ★
■ Improved Tutorials
● Chapter Select Improvements

After the Version 3.0 update, the Chapter Select feature is improved. Access it via Unbound Wharf in the Sea of Stars, or quickly via the Chapter Select button in the bottom-left corner of the Quests interface. Stylists can choose Main Story, Miracle Stories, and Island.
>> Main Story lets you travel to the Wishfield, Itzaland, or Cicia.

Note: For main story chapters not yet started, select \[begin your journey] to teleport directly to the story's beginning. For chapters in progress, tap Continue Journey to quickly locate and track the current quest.
>> Miracle Stories takes you to Sea of Stars and The Attic. Stylists who skipped the tutorial chapter can replay Sea of Stars once. The Attic opens as a side chapter, replayable once by all stylists.
>> Island lets you travel to Firework Isles, Serenity Island, Danqing Island, and Wanxiang Realm.
● Added Tutorial Chapter Skip Option
After the Version 3.0 update, once stylists complete the basic movement tutorial in the Sea of Stars, a popup lets them choose whether to skip the remaining tutorial chapters.

>> Choosing skip completes the quests "Through the Collapse of Time and Space" and "Where the Stars Keep Watch" and takes you to Unbound Wharf, unlocking Quests, Map, Wardrobe, Store, Camera, Friends, Co-op, and other features at the same time.
>> Stylists who skip can still replay Sea of Stars once later via \[Chapter Select], but replaying grants no rewards again.
>> Choosing not to skip continues the original tutorial chapter flow, and the popup will not appear again.

Note: This feature only applies to stylists entering the game for the first time after Version 3.0, or stylists who entered in earlier versions but have not completed the quest "A Journey Born from the End."
■ Resource Management Improvements

After the Version 3.0 update, PC and mobile (iOS & Android) add the Resource Management feature, letting stylists download or delete game resources as needed and manage device storage with greater ease.
>> Select the \[Resource Management] icon in the top-right corner of the login screen, or go to \[Pear-Pal > Settings > Resource Management] in game, to open the \[Resource Management] interface.
>> Resources are grouped under \, \, \, and \ tabs. Multi-select for batch download, or use \[Manage Deletions] to batch-delete downloaded resources and free up storage.
>> Download only \[Basic Resources] to enter the Sea of Stars and start playing. Area resources such as Wishfield, Itzaland, and Cicia, plus other resources, can be downloaded later as needed.
Note: Mac and PS5 do not yet support Resource Management.
Note: For more on resource management, see the system notice "Version 3.0 Resource Update Guide."
■ Clothing Optimizations
● Improved Solo Interaction with Duo Decorations

After the Version 3.0 update, when interacting with a duo decoration outside Co-op, choose Solo or Mirror Duo mode. With Mirror Duo, you can further select the interaction point and customize the styling of the mirror Nikki at the other position.
● Added Whimsicality Ability Progress Bar
After the Version 3.0 update, when using certain Whimsicality abilities, drag the progress bar to view any moment of the performance, or pause the performance to enter photography.
■ More Custom Schemes
After the Version 3.0 update, the maximum number of custom schemes for certain features increases. Stylists can create and save more custom schemes.
>> The maximum number of Ability custom schemes increased from 3 to 4.
>> The maximum number of Looks in the Wardrobe increased from 7 to 12.
>> The maximum number of Custom Avatar schemes increased from 5 to 7.
>> The maximum number of Custom Card schemes increased from 5 to 7.
Note: Stylists can also purchase the Half-Year Promise to enjoy exclusive privileges that further increase the scheme limits for Wardrobe, Ability Setup, Custom Avatar, and Custom Card.
■ Dash Optimizations
After the Version 3.0 update, charge storage will be enabled for Dash, improving the experience of moving quickly or dodging damage.
>> Unused dash charges can be stored. Stored dash charges can be released all at once or used one at a time.
>> Dash can be used multiple times successively, and dash charges recover over time.
>> The maximum number of dash charges can be increased by changing the equipped weapon type, or by upgrading Fearless Radiance in the Heart of Infinity.
■ Control Adjustments
● PC

After the Version 3.0 update, the default control for casting Whim Essence changes from the "Left Mouse Button" + "Q" combo to "Left Ctrl," reducing accidental inputs with Plunge, Special Musket Attachments, Guardian Veil, and other actions during combat.

Note: After the Version 3.0 update, since multiple new gameplay features and system functions are added, if your custom bindings conflict with the new default, you can adjust them in \[Controls > Key Settings].
● Controller
After the Version 3.0 update, when using the "Optimal" control scheme with a musket or staff equipped, the Plunge control changes:
>> PS5 controller: from holding "R2" to holding "R2" + "□" together.
>> PC controller: from holding "RT" to holding "RT" + "X" together.
■ Other

● Improved the display and filtering of map markers. When viewing areas with multiple vertical layers, markers on other layers are dimmed. A "Whim Marks" tab has been added to Filter Markers, which now shows only marker types present in the current area. The reward claim button in the bottom-left corner of the map can now be collapsed to keep more of the map visible.

notes.title: ● Improved the Store and Resonance interfaces

items.text: >> Improved the Store interface, which now displays in full screen. Some items support dynamic video backgrounds to show their effects more clearly.
>> Improved the rerun limited-time Resonance interface. A new "Rerun" tag helps stylists distinguish reruns from other types of Resonance more easily.

● Improved Momo's styling. The existing Momo's Wardrobe and Momo Combat will be merged into Momo Styling, where you can switch between them with ease to dress Momo and adjust his combat setup more conveniently.
● Improved the Video Mode on Mac: click the download button to save video clips recorded in Video Mode to the system album.

● Adjusted the binding experience for Night Baron. After the Version 3.0 update, while bound, consuming Veiling Energy to unleash Baron's Echo can temporarily block Essence Orbs fired by nearby Esselings, but it will no longer reveal Whimstars, chests, or Dews of Inspiration within the echo's range.
★ Fixed Issues ★
● Fixed an issue where the clothing pieces available in custom styling schemes were incorrect when Heart Rainbow or Shadow Bow was equipped.

Note: After the version update, if a custom styling scheme includes any disabled pieces from the issue fix, it may temporarily become invalid. Stylists can equip Archery, then go to the outfit customization screen to adjust the custom styling scheme based on the disabled piece markers.

● Fixed an issue where Concealment would be removed incorrectly after entering the state with the "Dust-Shrouded Crime" outfit, then switching to the "Tide of Tears" outfit and using the "Tidal Lament: World Rhythms" ability.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the dress "White Loong Pool" displayed incorrectly when paired with the outerwear "Pale Moonlight."
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the outfit "Snowbloom Wishsong" behaved incorrectly.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the ribbons on the hair "Gifted Sunlight" and on its Evolution and Glow-Up pieces disappeared unexpectedly.
● Fixed an issue where the dye effects on the top "Joyful Forever" displayed incorrectly.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the dress "Tender Twilight" displayed incorrectly when paired with the outerwear "Ancient Scrolls".
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the bottom "Vanishing Spring" behaved incorrectly when paired with boots.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, Nikki's hands behaved incorrectly when interacting with the decoration "Snug Surprise Stocking."
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the neckwear "Blue Teardrop" displayed incorrectly after zooming in on mobile devices.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the "Bloomlight Shadowcatcher: Bug-Catching" ability behaved incorrectly.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, Nikki's ankle model behaved incorrectly in the "The Little Prince" area.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the location shown in Collections was incorrect.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, stylists could not track materials in Collections.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, stylists could not talk to some NPCs in Heaven's Reach.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the View button disappeared from photos shared in mobile chat.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, Nearby Inspiration refreshed photos from an area other than the stylist's current location.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the Color Lookbook displayed abnormally.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the Snapshot button appeared before the feature was unlocked, and snapshots could not be taken.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, stylists unexpectedly obtained Whimstars after adjusting the time with Run, Pear-Pal.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, recording in Video Mode did not work correctly on Mac.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, the game could crash unexpectedly when talking to NPCs.
● Fixed an issue where some mobile devices crashed unexpectedly when forced into portrait mode.
● Fixed an issue where, under certain conditions, some animations behaved incorrectly on Mac devices.
● Fixed an issue where the game might not load correctly on certain devices.
● Fixed an issue where the display could be incorrect on certain devices.
● Fixed some text and translation errors.

releases.displayName: New Game Announcement + Update on Hexologic

items.text: Hello Hexologic & Puzzle fans from all around the planet! 👋

We're super excited for two reasons. First thing is - Hexologic will be getting another update next month, focused on some of the stuff you recently reported and were kind enough to share on our Steam forums.

Last month with a Free-To-Keep deal on Steam, we welcomed more than 1.5 million new players who added Hexologic to their Steam libraries. Reviews and feedback kept flowing, player base kept growing and we were humbled to see all the kind words (100% from recent reviews!) about our puzzle gem.
So our next game is our tribute to you guys - fans of puzzlers that appreciate the challenge and want to exercise their braincells - and send some undead to the oblivion when doing it!
Ladies & Gentlemen... Enter the world of Dungoku and check out the brand new announcement trailer!
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/BMigahgDeBA"]
🔢 Sudoku meets dungeon crawling: Use logic and deduction to locate hidden monsters on a grid-based dungeon map.
[p align="justify"]⚖️ Risk and reward: Make the right call to earn gold, or face the consequences of a wrong guess.
[p align="justify"]🛠️ 100+ handcrafted dungeons: Explore increasingly more complex environments as you descend the Spire.
[p align="justify"]⚔️ 70+ weapons, armour and items: Build your arsenal and improve your chances of survival as every item offers a different strategic buff.
[p align="justify"]👹 20+ monsters: Face skeletons, zombies and a variety of other undead enemies.
[p align="justify"]👾 Classic pixel-art presentation: A distinctive visual style built around retro palettes.
[p align="justify"]🔮 Retro dark fantasy atmosphere: Atmospheric ambient sounds and human-composed music bring the world to life.
Wishlist Dungoku ahead of its launch next month!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5554930/Dungoku/"]

notes.title: 准备好一起 GRIME 了吗！

items.text: 我们一直在为《GRIME》和《GRIME II》开发基于 Steam P2P 技术的合作模式（CO-OP）。
目前，我们正在 Discord 社区中进行测试，并计划于明年上半年正式推出这两款游戏的合作模式！

Greetings Adventurers!
The Dust to Dust Character Pack and A Mother Below Adventure have been out for a few weeks now, and we’ve loved seeing all of the discourse around these two new characters.

The Pugilist is winning hearts across the land with their combos and panache, while the Gravedigger's Soul Lantern captures not just the souls of their enemies, but the tactical minds of our players too!
If you're yet to grab the Dust to Dust Character Pack, dive into the link below to learn more about the wild additions you'll gain access to with this DLC.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/5169060/For_The_King_II_Dust_to_Dust_Character_Pack/"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42430794/1193ab92b1f058e4b66d96c7edcd4f1f26a032fa.png"]

We’ve gone through so many comments and feedback about his power and what he brings to the table. This patch, we haven’t changed any of his stats as we’re currently comfortable with where he is at in the party. He can do a bunch of damage, but you need to ensure his combos go off, and that requires knowing the systems and mechanics to get the best out of him. For experienced players, he’s a ready-to-pop punching machine; for new players, he’s a great way to learn about a lot of systems, statuses, mechanics, and so much more.
The Gravedigger

One certain thing we’ve learned reading all of the feedback is that this character is a rollercoaster! We knew the Gravedigger was going to be a polarizing character as we were designing them. They’re quite a complex character that requires careful management of souls. Stay too long in Ardent or Gloom, and you could end up having a tough time.
Learn the balance of either Ardent or Gloom, though, and you can become a soul-stealing, damage-dealing monster.

As our 25th character for For The King II, we wanted to provide a character that allowed players to utilize all of the knowledge they gained throughout all the wild adventures they’ve gone on over the three years since we first launched the game.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42430794/27885d4cfc6dac70f805280a10ce35773fb598d0.png"]

For both characters, we will continue to review feedback and see how they continue to perform in the community. We are open to future balancing, so please keep sharing your feedback, your highlights, and lowlights; we love seeing all the community stories that play out throughout the realm of Fahrul.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42430794/1193ab92b1f058e4b66d96c7edcd4f1f26a032fa.png"]
Today's patch delivers a round of quality-of-life updates, bug fixes, and minor tweaks.
Championship Belts have been set to Unique as intended. This way, each belt will appear at most once per adventure.
Fixed an issue where backing out of Focus when using a bomb could allow glass or luck weapons to be focused.
Fixed an issue in A New Age where loading specific saves could skip Chaos timeline events.
Fixed the issue where the inventory was missing info during the Adventure Summary.
Fixed an issue where Game Resolution (Focused, Windowed) was not saving correctly and reverted to default when the game was shut down.
Fixed an issue where the Hangman Scourge’s Cursed Ghosts could cause a softlock if there is no room to summon them in during dungeons.
Fixed a softlock that could occur if a follower received more than 8 status effects.
Fixed a softlock that could occur when teleporting onto a Minecart in The Royal Mines.
Fixed a softlock that could occur if a Client disconnects from the game while another player is “crafting” with the Beekeeper
Fixed an Online softlock that could occur when playing in Dark Carnival Fahrulian Fortune.
Fixed an issue in online play where a player randomizing their character would close another player’s cosmetic menu.
Improved the Online Turn Start notification sound timing to better alert players when it’s their turn.
Fixed an issue where Party Heal was not giving equipped Pipe benefits to the caster when used in dungeon rest phase.
Fixed an issue where abilities that break equipment (i.e. Mimic, crab) ignored the Protect ability.
Fixed an issue where the Toymaker could not cast Plaything on Parasitic or Isopore enemies.
Fixed an issue where the last character to Rest in dungeon rest phase does not have their follower gain the benefits of an Angler’s grilled fish.
Fixed an issue where the game could become partially locked when moving onto a point of interest immediately after using a Portal Scroll.
Fixed an issue where enemy combat hexes were removed on the Overworld after inspecting an enemy encounter and backing out.
Fixed an issue in the first combat of A Mother Below where a player could have their second wave turn skipped after delivering the killing blow in the first wave.
Fixed an issue where the Gravedigger’s Requiem skill would not always have the correct overworld popcorn text.
Fixed an issue where the Voidwalker’s Resonator upgrade UI could conflict with the Gravedigger Soul Lantern UI.
Fixed an issue where the Pugilist combat menu could overlap with Enemy compact HUDs.
Fixed an issue where an enemy combat HUD could remain on screen when quitting to the main menu.
Fixed a debug artifact on the main menu news system.
Improved the spacing on the VFX for the Concentration status received from the Tarot Concentration.
Fixed an issue where certain no-damage abilities (i.e. Attack Down) were not displaying any popcorn text in combat.
Fixed an issue where treasure enemies (i.e. slippery pirate, silver snake) were missing their enemy icon in their encounter menu.
Fixed an issue where certain Pugilist SFX were not present.
Improved the Friar’s Cheers skill proc SFX
In A Mother Below, improved Aiden’s death SFX to smooth out through the cloud animation.
Improved Everbloom Canopy overworld audio.
Fixed an issue where rain could incorrectly remove shadows in an Everbloom Canopy combat.
Fixed an issue where certain Sea Caves could have their water lighting flicker unexpectedly.
Fixed an issue where the Everbloom Helmet’s eyes didn’t always match between their HUD profile and character model.
Fixed an issue where Confetti Blood was not always splattering (confetti-ing?) correctly.
Improved the encounter camera for the Sticky Situation encounter when arachnophobia mode is enabled.
Improved fog in Everbloom Canopy dungeons when playing on High or Dream.
Fixed an issue where the Blacksmith Husk in A Mother Below could have a floating mushroom prop attached to its helmet.
Improved the Angler’s ready-up animation where he was switching from fish to weapon too quickly.
Fixed an issue where the Input Binding menu was not always scrolling according to the set scroll speed.
Fixed an issue where pressing the back button in list views would not always return the character to the correct window.
Fixed an issue on PlayStation 5 where Everbloom Canopy dungeons could have a white flash during a dungeon room transition.

The Blood and Ice expansion with the new Polar Sink map is now available on the Public Test Client! To minimize spoilers and avoid frostbite, we've decided to make the testing phase shorter than usual, focusing solely on critical issues that might have slipped past our internal QA.
[p align="start"]As always, please utilize the in-game bug reporting option to notify our team about any major problems you’ll encounter during playtesting.

[p align="start"]Don’t forget to take advantage of the Progression Unlock Panel (only available in the PTC) where aside from getting resources and gear, XP and unlocking Journey chapters, you can unlock faction ranks and crafting materials.
[p align="start"]New to PTC? Learn more about our Public Test Clients and how they work here. The best place to discuss the PTC is the relevant Steam Discussion Board and our PTC Discord server.
[p align="start"]
Get warmed up with a hot cup of melange spiced coffee and set off for the Polar Sink! Discover new locations, enemies, hazards, and more in this new map.

Find and craft new augments for Unique Plastanium-tier power packs, shields, and vehicle PSUs. These upgrades can boost stats like power capacity and shield recovery speed, or enhance entire vehicles with increased cargo capacity, higher mining yields, stronger armor, and more.

Unlock new traits across all specialization tracks by spending Spice once you meet or exceed the track’s progression level requirements. Some of the new traits can enhance ice processing, improve ice mining and sandcrawler efficiency, or increase the maximum sub-fief limit.

Expand your base with new stations, such as the Ice Refinery, Polar Fabricator, and Industrial Cooling System. Organize your supplies in specialized containers like Mineral Vaults and Sand Silos, and haul water using your Buggy and Ornithopters using the new vehicle water storage modules.

Explore The Facility, a new dungeon set deep in the core of the Ice Cap. This dungeon is unlocked as part of the main Polar Sink story line. Completing this dungeon at level 20 rewards players with a special Paragon of the Polar Sink armor customization variant.
Deal a new damage type, Cryo, that can apply Brittleness, a new debuff effect. When affected by Brittleness, health damage taken is increased.

Take on seven new Landsraad missions, benefit from four new Landsraad decrees, and earn improved Landsraad personal contribution rewards that contain components from the Polar Sink and some new Polar Sink unique schematics.
Store water in the new unique Carrier Ornithopter Water Container. This container works the same as the cargo container but instead holds 3,000,000ml of water.
Override per-map sub-fief limits on private servers with new server setting.
Check out all the patch notes here.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/287ef8baa3a29f1f662fa9051fdb65262b9484cc.png"]We have confirmed the use of modified PlayStation 4 consoles to gain an unfair advantage in Apex Legends. Our Anti-Cheat team has implemented dedicated detection measures to identify players using these modifications and we have been in contact with Sony. Players identified using modified hardware to cheat will receive hardware bans on their consoles.
We understand the frustration this has caused. Playing on console does not provide an exemption from detection or enforcement.
Thank you to everyone who continues to report suspicious behavior and helps keep Apex Legends fair.

notes.title: We have released an update with the following changes

items.text: \[Bug Fixes]
・In intense combat scenarios, the field of vision for allied CPU units during their turn was not displaying correctly.
・In the "Unit Production" menu, the "Progress to Next Tech Level" counter would continue to increment even after the technology level had reached its maximum value.
As a precaution, we have made it possible to revert to a previous version using the "Beta" (beta branch) feature on Steam.
If you encounter any issues after applying this patch, you can switch back to an earlier version via the "Beta" menu in Steam.
We hope you continue to enjoy *Daisenryaku SSB2*.
Fellow Greymanes,
Here are the fixes and improvements that have been added this patch.
Major Updates
This patch adds various bug fixes and stability improvements.
Update Schedule
The patch is rolling out across all platforms.
Please refer to the Update section below to see the state of the patch for each platform.
Update
Steam (PC): Patch available now
Steam (Mac): Patch available now
Patch Details
Main Improvements
Content
Improved the inventory system to allow items obtained from add-on content to be stored in storages.
Improved the placement system for houses and management facilities.
Improved the installable items so they can be placed without owning them.
Once you register an installable item, you can place additional copies by spending camp resources, without needing to own more of them.
Installable items that have already been placed will be registered automatically.
If you have placed two or more copies of the same item, the price of all but one copy will be refunded.
Unplaced furniture can now be sold at furniture shops.
Rare installable items that were previously limited to one can now be placed multiple times using Camp Resources after registering them.
Adjusted the placement costs of installable items.
Placement costs are determined by an item’s Management-related stats, size, and stat type. Items that contribute more to Management facilities have higher placement costs.
Added a function to Home Decoration and Free Construction modes that allows you to place or remove paths across a large area more easily.
"Portable Wooden Toilets" and "Supply Storage" can now be placed as housing items.
Improved the housing system so that the area where wallpaper is applied can be adjusted.
Improved the housing system so that when there are multiple interactable targets, you can now switch between them using the d-pad
Adjusted the maximum Installable Points for Management facilities and the Management stats of installable items.
Placement Scores, Facility Grades, and Daily Upkeep Costs may change after the update, even if no changes have been made.

items.text: Hey Anno Community,
Last week we released patch 3.0.1 with a large number of bug fixes and some changes, which you can review here.

We unfortunately also introduced some new issues that were discovered too late to still be included in this patch and want to apologize for the inconveniences this is currently causing. Last Friday, we deployed a hotfix on all platforms to address the following two issues:
Invisible ornaments
Ornaments being buildable in the harbour area
On December 10th we’re planning to release one more patch, for which we’re looking into, amongst other things:
Fixes for more specialists (incl. gold in Aegyptus)
Continued crashes on PS5
Issues with the shaders on PC following version 3.0.1
Behaviour and progression of rivals, specifically Decimus
We’ll keep you updated on the status of this patch.
Before the end of the year, we have one more livestream planned:
On December 10th, we’ll be holding our usual end-of-the-year livestream. We’ll be recapping the year and offering you a brief look at what 2027 will bring.
Tune in, as usual, at 4PM UTC | 5PM CET on our Anno Twitch channel.
Not a week goes by without great creations by our community, even more so after the releases of new content like Dawn of the Delta.
Let’s start with the topics of Stamps then! You have created some stamps following the recent update and want to share them with the world? Or are looking for interesting layouts from other people?
Check out https://annostamps.com/! The Anno 1800 veterans among you already know this website from back then, now its creator also implemented a dedicated category for Anno 117: Pax Romana.

Many of the player-created tools we’ve featured in previous Community Spotlights received updates and improvements and as in the past, we certainly recommend you checking them out if you’re looking for calculators, item overviews and more. We’re going to list three of them below, you can find some more on our Community Page on the Anno Union.
https://annotoolkit.com/ by Admiral General Aladeen
https://anno-companion.com/117/tools/ by Taludas
https://anno-mods.github.io/anno-117-calculator/ by DuxVitae
You also shared a crazy amount of screenshots and we want to give them a platform in a future Community Spotlight, so, keep posting impressions from your savegames and stay tuned for the next blog.
Finally, it never hurts having a look at mod.io, as plenty of mods have not only been updated recently but we could also see many new mods joining the platform recently.
Play “Hyper Thrilling Don-chan Land”, a new mode with 4 mini-games made by Don-chan now Unexpected events might happen....so be sure to check it out!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170838/a0cc7e69bfe0c65ab859c590511e4f8584634f38.jpg"]
A new song, “Kimi wa doko?”, written exclusively by Sho Kiryuin of GOLDEN BOMBER, has been added! Don-chan and friends appear on the performance screen, sporting new looks!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45170838/684fb16cfa14e4ea37cb07af6b9cfb3c9b04fd40.jpg"]
Eight new mini characters of Don-chan with fresh new looks are available to play! Have fun with your favorite Don-chan!

Greetings Detectives, we’ve got a new patch for you coming out soon!

Currently we’re aiming to get this to you fully by the end of the month, but for those of you who want access a little bit sooner, we’ve released it already on our experimental branch whilst we iron out the last few kinks.

More info coming soon, but the main headline is we’ve fixed a major memory leak. This will help when repeatedly starting or loading a new game and will benefit all platforms for those of you who also play on console.
Happy sleuthing detectives! Patch notes below 🧪⚙️
Fixed: Significant memory leak when starting or loading a new game when a game was already loaded.
Fixed: Internal error when the game was asked to draw a room of size 0 x 0 on the map.
Fixed: When using a gamepad, pressing the up/down floor buttons on the map would register twice.

Fixed: Wrong evidence types appearing as ‘entry wound’, plus entry wound evidence type now features a ‘found on’ connection. This fix will require a new game. Note: Pinned entry wounds in save games from previous versions may need to be re-pinned.
Fixed: Citizens will no longer get stuck in the answering phone loop while Player fast forwards time.
Fixed: Citizens can no longer buy or attempt to buy things from empty/unoccupied street vendor carts.
Fixed: Sync Disk Rewards will now spawn and retain their objective link from Side Jobs.
Fixed: You can no longer use Micro Cruncher's that are occupied.
Fixed: A few edge cases with players losing their input state when text input fields are present for case board elements.
Fixed: Makes sure the above fix doesn't conflict or compete with the on-screen keyboard.
Fixed: Glass shards would not spawn after loading a game if the player had smashed lots of windows in their previous game.
Fixed: Game would spawn limited spatter particles on game load if the previous game had a lot (500 max).
Fixed: Displayed debug text on the black and white buttons on the evidence window pin button context menu.
Fixed: In text, hair length descriptions are not being followed by “hair”, causing confusing sentence syntax.
Fixed: Edge case of the social credit perk of being allowed at crime scenes not working.
Removed some unused Unity packages previously present in the build (like analytics).
We have just deployed an update, to resolve the following 2 issues:
Fixed an Issue where the names of dropped Items would be displayed ontop of each other.
Fixed an Issue with incorrect Item tooltips when selling items to traders.
Due to increased submission requests before christmas at Nintendo,
this patch has not yet been released on the Nintendo Switch, but will follow in the near future.
Two things are certain in a witcher's life: the Path never sleeps, and the work is never done.

Patch 5.02 for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered is now available! From gameplay and balance and visual adjustments to Photo Mode improvements, to plenty fixes across the Continent and more, this update brings a host of changes to make your adventures on the Path even better.
Read the list of changes below for a breakdown of what's included in Patch 5.02:
Gameplay
The Zoltan Chivay gwent card will now properly appear under the Hanged Man's Tree in Velen.
Fixed an issue where installing and uninstalling mods could cause merchants' inventories, Geralt's inventory and storage to be emptied.
Fixed an issue that prevented the player from interacting with merchants.
Fixed an issue where loading a New Game+ save on the Remastered version could increase the level requirement of some items.
Fixed an issue where loading a New Game+ save on the Remastered version reset the additional damage value of the Aerondight sword.
Implemented fixes and balance changes for multiple Skills and Mutations:
Acquired Tolerance - Updated the description to accurately reflect the skill's effect.
Catalyst - Reduced the Aard and Igni intensity bonus by 10%.
Chain Reaction - Fixed an issue where other witchers could trigger the skill by casting Signs.
Flood of Anger - Fixed an issue where the Sign Intensity bonus wouldn't trigger while Geralt was affected by a damage-over-time status.
Fortify Signs - Fixed the skill duration calculation.
Lightning Reflexes - Time will now be properly slowed down while aiming the crossbow.
Sustained Glyphs - Reduced the Sign duration bonus by 3 seconds.
Sign skills - Reduced stamina regeneration in combat to 0.25/s per level.
Chain Reaction - Fixed an issue where casting the same Sign twice in a row prevented it from starting a new Chain Reaction.
Delayed Recovery - Can now also be used with Decoctions.
Sunder Armor - Fixed an issue where the damage resistance reduction only applied to Strong Attacks instead of all attacks.
Adrenaline Rush - Reduced the Attack Power and Sign Intensity bonus by 20%. Reduced the Attack Power and Sign Intensity debuff to 5% per enemy and the max debuff to 25%.
Cat Eyes - Reduced the damage bonus by 50.
Magic Sensibilities - Reduced critical hit chance by 15%. Reduced critical hit damage by 50%.
Mutated Skin - Lowered the damage reduction by 5% per Adrenaline Point.
Piercing Cold - Reduced the damage bonus by 500.
Scenes From a Marriage - Fixed an issue where the camera could become temporarily unresponsive during the fight with Iris' Greatest Fear when Target Locking was set to Modern.
Fixed an issue where fast traveling to Oxenfurt Harbor multiple times by boat could cause Geralt's boat to move unnaturally fast and clip through terrain.
Kaer Morhen - Fixed an issue where targeting Vesemir during a specific time window could block progression in the tutorial.
Fixed an issue where meditating until the next full hour for less than a minute could cause time to go backwards indefinitely, making it impossible to end the meditation.

Fixed an issue where switching to the Bard's Ballad accessibility preset didn't enable the "Ignore Item Weight" option until an item was picked up. For an overview of the features included in Bard’s Ballad, check out this article.
Fixed an issue where triggering a cutscene while dying in combat could cause the game to get stuck on an infinite loading screen.
Fixed an issue where Geralt could would grab onto a ladder mid-air after jumping off it.
Fixed an issue where werewolves could regenerate health too quickly on higher difficulty settings, making them impossible to defeat.
The Maiming Shot, Muscle Memory, Strength Training, and Crushing Blow skills will now work properly.
Updated the descriptions of the Sunder Armor, Potent Sting, Poisoned Blades, Active Shield, and Crippling Strikes skills to better reflect their effects.
The Aerondight sword will now work properly with the Muscle Memory, Three Strikes, Strength Training, and Crushing Blow skills.
Fixed an issue where the Eredin: Commander of the Red Riders Gwent card couldn't be purchased from Jonas the Innkeep.
Visual
Fixed an issue where Reforging the Mastercrafted or Grandmaster Feline armor gave Geralt an unusual hairstyle.
Fixed an issue where Geralt and NPCs could be missing faces or other body parts.
Fixed an issue where growing a beard with the Rabble-rouser hairstyle made Geralt's head invisible.
Fixed an issue where some armor had a blue glow when Ray Tracing was enabled.
Fixed an issue where Geralt could become bald after enabling HairWorks on PC or Xbox Play Anywhere and then continuing the game on Xbox via Cross Progression.
Fixed wrinkles not appearing correctly on some characters' faces.
Fixed an issue where a building in the Novigrad Docks disappeared when moving close to it.
Fixed various lighting issues across multiple locations and cutscenes, including overly bright or dark areas, inconsistent lighting transitions and flickering.
Fixed the appearance of water surfaces in dark areas with Screen Space Reflections set to Low.
Fixed an issue where the animation for getting off a ladder could be misaligned on some ladders.
Fixed some visual and stability issues with HairWorks.
Fixed an issue where some NPCs in crowds had overly bright red areas on their legs.
A Midnight Clear - Fixed an issue where a bard was playing an invisible drum during a cutscene.
A Midnight Clear - Fixed an issue where Shani teleported in the background of a cutscene.
Contract: An Elusive Thief - Fixed an issue where the doppler didn't copy the appearance of Geralt's reforged armor.
Fixed an issue where the hilts of certain swords were missing their intended colors.
UI
Fixed an issue where quest markers for all active quest in the Journal could appear on the minimap at the same time.
Fixed various UI issues, including incorrect spacing, overlapping, misaligned or cut-off elements, incorrectly positioned markers, missing button hints, placeholder characters, and more.
Added an option in the Interface settings to hide the UI when the game is paused, allowing the scene and subtitles to remain clearly visible.
Updated skill tooltips to allow cycling through all levels of a skill.
Fixed an issue where unobtainable items could appear in the Reforge menu.
Fixed an issue where the UI could be permanently hidden in the main menu until the game was restarted.
Added support for the 32:9 (super-ultrawide) aspect ratio.
Quests
Contract: Missing Son - Fixed an issue where, if the player saved the game after approaching Morvudd and then died during combat, Geralt could become invincible after loading the save.
Contract: Missing Son - Fixed an issue where, under specific circumstances, Morvudd could be killed during his first phase.
Tedd Deireadh, The Final Age - Fixed an issue that caused a significant performance drop that could result in a crash.
High Stakes - Fixed an issue where the Eredin: Bringer of Death card wasn't awarded after defeating Tybalt in Gwent.
Empty Coop - Fixed an issue where the quest couldn't be started because Yanina was missing.
The Last Wish - Fixed the infinite loading screen that occurred after giving Philippa's crystal to Yennefer.
PC-specific
Fixed an issue where launching the game with outdated mods caused the game to crash and display a compilation error instead of disabling them and displaying a warning about outdated mods.
Fixed an issue on SteamDeck where starting a Hearts of Stone-only or Blood and Wine-only game would take a long time to load.
Fixed an issue where Xbox and PlayStation controllers with haptic feedback connected to a PC could still vibrate when playing with a keyboard and mouse.
Fixed various lighting issues with hair when Path Tracing is enabled.
Made various Path Tracing and Ray Reconstruction optimizations and visual improvements, including lighting, shadows, and water rendering.
Added Ukrainian translations for Steam Achievements.
Miscellaneous
Fixed the Rabble-Rouser hairstyle appearing among the beard options at the Claywich barber.
Fixed an issue where repeatedly changing certain options in Photo Mode could cause the game to crash.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629220/2c35e4367d1270b0103a4f7508756662f8b61dff.png"]

We've been hard at work on our first major content update for Chained Beasts. Due to popular demand, we have added in a meta progression system in which you will unlock new tattoos, purchases, skills and afflictions as you play the game.

The game will still be skill-based, as these unlocks will not make you stronger through grinding. Instead, they will let you further customize your character and build, as well as provide more variety each time you play.
But there's still more to come! The new Rome Act, with a new big boss, new enemies and new weapons is still on schedule to arrive in December as we outlined in our roadmap.

Console versions of Chained Beasts will receive the Blood & Ink update soon. If you wish to keep playing Crossplay multiplayer with console players, please use the crossplaycompatibility Steam branch. To access this branch:
Right Click on Chained Beasts in your Steam Library > Properties > Game Versions & Betas > Select the crossplaycompatibility branch
Unlock 24 tattoos and choose 3 each run to customize your character with powerful bonuses and stat improvements.

After each run, your crowd score will grant you Glory levels which will unlock tattoos for your collection and add new skills, purchases, afflictions to the available pools that your runs can select from. Play with your friends and experience the combined pools of all your unlocks!

If you have beaten the game on Jupiter and we haven't yet ground down your will to survive, you can equip one of 5 terrible cursed tattoos and work your way through the difficulties again (from Pleb+ to Jupiter+) in your new cursed state. It's the ultimate challenge for battle-hardened gladiators!
24 Tattoos
5 Cursed tattoos
14 New Skills
6 New Afflictions
5 New Purchases
2 New Missions
7 New Arena Layouts
Damage Numbers
No Blood Mode
The "take at least X hits" mission is now "take at least X damage", scaled to your expected health for that day. Damage from burning, afflictions and pit falls counts towards it.
Panther: damage bonus increased from +25% to +30%.
Unrelenting Panther: the consecutive-hit damage bonus now stacks up to 6 hits (was 4).
Stomping Rhino: stun duration bonus increased from +50% to +100%.
Wolf: higher chance to dismember enemies on a kill (20% → 24%).
Ravenous Wolf: picking up limbs now heals 4% of max health (was 3%).
Perfect Form: damage bonus decreased from +50% to +45%, and now needs 85% health (was 80%).
Slight increase in some of the higher difficulty increases to account for Tattoos.
Praefectus boss: reinforcements arrive a little more slowly.
Co-op: the Trainer offers affliction removal less often.
Hard Learned Lessons: Damage per skull decreased from +3% to +2% ,and max level decreased from 4 to 2.
Lobotomy surgery will no longer be offered with too few injury removals.
Shower of Splinters: thrown shields now also explode when they break.
Paranoia: Hallucinated enemies appear less often.
Infatuation: in online games, when the camera follows an ally and you go off screen, a marker on the screen edge points to you.
Nerve Damage: training with only one strain pip left now gives 1 XP instead of 2.
Skull counts no longer include surgery results (affects Hard Learned Lessons, Scar Tissue, Clear-Headed and the Medical Marvel achievement).
Less Expensive: Pain Killers 70 → 65, Priceless Vase 40 → 35, Pamphlets 50 → 40, Obsidian Harpoon 50 → 40, Obsidian Hammer 60 → 55.
More Expensive: Whetstone 55 → 60, Grinding Wheel 40 → 45, Horns for the Crowd 25 → 30, Concealed Blade 40 → 55.
You can no longer block while holding a two-handed weapon (with your shield on your back) just because you have the Arm Surgical Rod.
Effects that a block stops are still stopped if the shield breaks on that same hit.
Fixed attacks wrongly counting (or not counting) as unarmed damage: the Obsidian Hammer and Drive It Home bonus damage no longer count, and Knuckle Dusters now boosts thrown enemy damage.
Enemies no longer back right up into walls.
The Ballista no longer get blocked by formation enemies directly in front of it.
The Doctor no longer offers the same random-affliction potion twice, and offers at most one random potion per visit.
Fixed an issue where weapons that get put down instantly were behaving strangely when knocked out of an embedded object in the environment.
Executions can no longer be cancelled on the same frame that the kill occurs.
The mouse cursor is confined to the game window during battle in fullscreen.
Afflictions only one player can have (such as Show-Off) can no longer be given to two players on the same day, including through Mark of Bondage.
Boosted throws (such as with the Eagle tattoo) no longer sail over enemies' heads.
Sweaty Palms no longer makes you drop a flail when you throw it.
New difficulty selection UI in the lobby
The mouse can now highlight elements in the character info bar.
Shop price changes are shown more clearly.
Fixed the results screen when players lose money for the day.
Fixed d-pad navigation in local multiplayer.
Fixed local co-op lobby preferences (beast, gender, cosmetic, colour) landing on the wrong player.
Gameplay hints now display on the loading screen after each battle
Fixed a skill level number showing on empty skill slots in the lobby.
Hobbies now reveals the right two skills at the Trainer when one of them levels up a skill you already have.
Added new Tattoo section and tattoo badges.
After winning a run, you will now see the Codex difficulty badge increasing for each skill, affliction, purchase, and tattoo you had equipped.
Your Beast and Glory level is shown on a pedestal on the Codex main menu.
Rock, Scroll and Torch now appear in the weapons Codex.
New opponent Codex entries are now cleared when you close the menu.
Fixed the Favourite Beast showing the wrong beast name.
The Scholarly achievement now also requires discovering every tattoo.
New avoid-attack SFX.
Added Drop SFX for overhead weapons that can now be put down, and pickup SFX for the chain ball and chain log.
New sounds added when players flex at the end of battles.

[p align="center"]FIVE STORIES TO FOLLOW IN STOCKHOLM
Sixteen teams, three regions, and every opening Cashout mixes them. Here’s five stories we can’t wait to see play out.
[p align="center"]LAST YEARS CHAMPIONS, SPLIT IN TWO
Gremlin, UNI and Lasagna won the 2025 Grand Major as NTMR. Gremlin and UNI now play for ENVY. Lasagna stayed at NTMR to rebuild, and is back again to prove his side is the stronger one.
[p align="center"]ARE FIVE FEARS THE KINGS OF EMEA?

No team in EMEA came close to scoring the points that Five Fears had across the Online Series. They locked their invite with a cycle to spare. They’re seed 2 overall, and they open in Lobby B alongside NTMR.
[p align="center"]
[p align="center"]IS THIS LUMINON GAMING’S YEAR?
Last year, the roster of Lamp, Grad and Normalize fought up until the final day, but missed out on greatness. Will this be the time the squad can band together under the Luminon banner?
[p align="center"]KINGZERO STAND STRONG
Kingzero led APAC through the first two cycles, lost top spot after Cycle 3, then took it back in the final cycle to claim the region's direct invite. They will arrive as seed 3.
[p align="center"]THE BIGGEST GRAND MAJOR YET
Three days instead of two, $150,000 on the line, and for the first time, the title decided on The Throne format.

The Vanguard class receives a major expansion to its combat capabilities. The Grapnel Launcher can now be used at close range, making the ability more versatile and responsive in the heat of battle. The class perk tree has also undergone significant changes, with numerous perks reworked and repositioned, alongside new key perks designed to improve crowd control and increase effectiveness against groups of enemies. These include a new perk that allows the Grapnel Launcher to apply Stun and Revenge status effects.
Hitting enemies afflicted with Revenge status effect also deals damage to nearby enemies.
🟡Revenge base damage is increased by 50%;
🟡Revenge damage radius is increased from 10 to 12 meters;
🟡Revenge maximum number of targets is increased from 4 to 5 enemies;
🟡Revenge effect duration is increased from 8 to 10 seconds.

notes.title: Marvel Rivals Anniversary Celebration - Rivals' Day 2026

items.text: [p align="justify"]This week, our cosmic anniversary hub, the Galactic Center, opens its doors in full! An entire galaxy of fun-filled modes and blockbuster festivities is kicking into overdrive, with a treasure trove of rewards (including heaps of Units) waiting to be claimed! Whether you're a street-level vigilante or a cosmic powerhouse, we hope every Rival finds their own kind of fun here and makes truly Marvel-ous, unforgettable anniversary memories with their friends!
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]Insert Coin, Rivals Assemble! The newest hotspot in the Times Square Galactic Center, Ghostworks Arcade, is officially open! Six hero-powered arcade mini-games have united under one neon-lit roof, giving Earth's Mightiest Heroes a place to hang up their capes, step away from the crossfire, and dive into pure retro arcade mayhem. Smash your personal high scores and cheer on your fellow heroes' clutch plays, because the record they just set might be the next one you shatter! Round up your squad, hit the cabinets, and ignite the battle in a whole new kind of rivalry!

[p align="justify"]Conquer a series of action-packed mini-game challenges to score themed Sprays and exclusive Titles, and collect Arcade Stamps along the way to claim an extra 400 Units and the Arcade Ace Title!
[p align="justify"]Opens On: November 26th, 2026, at 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)
[p align="justify"]- JEFF'S CHOMPING CHAIN
A Jeff here, a Jeff there... Hey! quit wandering off! Fall in behind Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur and let's roll out together!
LAND SHARK SNACKER: An all-you-can-eat undersea feast might sink the submarine of friendship for good. Since it's going down anyway, you might as well eat to your heart's content!
BIG SHOT RIVALS: The showdown between Cap and The Hood rages on...and this time, the hoop will be the judge!
ROCKET'S JOYRIDE: Some mystery creep is trying to hijack the arcade cabinet Rocket was hauling! Show off your pinball wizardry and teach him a lesson!
HULK CAN JUMP!: Loki stole Hulk's favorite beans! Wait... those beans are magic beans?! Hurry and help Hulk leap across the pillars to get them back!
GALACTIC BEATS: Who doesn't want to be the dance champion of the cosmos? Hit every beat and light up the galaxy with your moves!: [p align="justify"]
Van Dyne's: Idea Matrix

[p align="justify"]Move over, Milan. Van Dyne's fashion boutique in the Galactic Center Plaza is officially open! To celebrate Rivals' Day 2026, Galacta herself is stepping behind the drawing board to tailor show-stopping, high-fashion threads worthy of the Chronoverse's finest!

Channel your inner Janet Van Dyne in the costume design mini-game to earn exchange currencies based on the quality of your Blueprints, then trade them in at the Exchange Store to snag the dazzling Legendary Deadpool - Moment Stealer costume and more for FREE! Plus, complete the Shining Compendium collection to take home the Accessory: Shining Galacta!
[p align="justify"]Event Period: November 26th, 2026, 09:00:00 to January 21st, 2027, 09:00:00 (UTC)
Voices of Heroes

[p align="justify"]Every hero has an origin story, and on our 2nd Anniversary, we want to hear yours! Swing by the red mailbox in Times Square and leave behind your own Marvel Rivals chronicle. Whether it's a legendary battle memory or honest feedback from the front lines, we'll read every single letter with care and spotlight select stories on the message board for all to see. You can even send a time-capsule letter across the Timestream to your future self. We'll lock it away tighter than the Sanctum Sanctorum and deliver it back to you at this exact time next year!
[p align="justify"]Event Period: November 26th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to December 24th, 2027, 09 : 00 : 00 (UTC)
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]The Black Friday Sale has landed for a limited time with deals so good even Tony Stark would look twice!

Head to the Black Friday tab in the Store and load up your Black Friday Cart with your favorite participating bundles. Every purchase automatically fuels your Black Friday Progress, unlocking super-heroic discounts of up to 40% OFF. The more you haul, the bigger the savings!

[p align="justify"]Better yet, hitting progress milestones unlocks limited-time rewards worthy of the Collector's vault. Including a one-of-a-kind, serial-numbered Black Friday 2026 commemorative Nameplate, Units, and an exclusive Title!

[p align="justify"]All eligible items are marked with a special Black Friday badge and can be snagged individually or bundled together in your Cart for a single checkout, where you can easily inspect your full discount breakdown and final sale prices at a glance!
[p align="justify"]Event Period: November 26th, 2026, 09 : 00 : 00 to December 1st, 2026, 08 : 00 : 00 (UTC)

[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]- Groot's Overeager Flora: Fixed an issue on the Museum of Contemplation map where attacking destructible map barriers while within the buff range of Groot's Ironwood Wall, Thornlash Wall, or Wild Wall would unintentionally trigger their Awakened effects (such as granting Bonus Health from Ironwood Wall). I am Groot, which means Groot's walls now know the difference between a real enemy and a doorway barrier!

Moon Knight's Lunar Blindspot: Fixed an issue where the Talons of Khonshu triggered by Moon Knight's Blood Moon Trap Team-Up Ability could not deal damage to map energy barriers. Nothing stands in the way of Khonshu's vengeance now, not even an energy shield!

Loki's Borrowed Brilliance: Resolved an issue where transforming into another hero via Loki's Villain's Illusion Team-Up Ability granted abnormally high Ultimate Ability charge efficiency while in that form. The God of Mischief loves a shortcut, but we've reigned in his borrowed power to keep the cosmos fair!: [p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]- Multiversal Footing Fix: Fixed several issues across the Museum of Contemplation, God Quarry, and Hydra Charteris Base maps where certain displacement or revival abilities (such as Adam Warlock's Ultimate Ability resurrection or Nightcrawler's Tandem Teleport) could cause characters to end up in abnormal positions. Your landings are now rock-solid across time and space!
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]- PS5 Spray Inspection Fix: Fixed an issue on PS5 where the right stick would stop responding on the out-of-match preview screen after equipping a Spray. Smooth camera control is back in your hands!

Winter Soldier's Silent Strike: Fixed an issue with the Winter Soldier - Starlit Gunslinger costume where the hit sound effect for his secondary fire would occasionally fail to play. Every Bucky hook now lands with the thunderous impact it deserves!
Wolverine's Accessory Alignment: Corrected an accessory placement issue on the Wolverine - X Deaths costume.
Wolverine's Fiery Claws: Fixed a visual display error with the weapon flame VFX on the Wolverine - Weapon PhoeniX costume. Logan's cosmic fire is burning bright and right once more!

Wolverine's Retracted Claws: Fixed an issue where Logan's claws failed to retract properly when playing the Deadly Precision emote during a match. Even the best there is knows when to sheathe the Adamantium!: [p align="justify"]: [p align="justify"]The Marvel Rivals universe is ever-evolving, and we have plenty more surprises and updates in store. Stay tuned to our official announcements for more!

Today's update coincides with the release of Operation Torch – the new singleplayer campaign DLC for Company of Heroes 3. In support of this DLC we are also releasing a small patch to address bugs and feedback since the release of update 3.0.0.

Take command of U.S. forces during the Allied invasion of North Africa and lead them through one of the most pivotal campaigns of the Second World War. Inspired by the historic Operation Torch campaign, this new narrative-driven single-player Campaign puts players in command of a force that must learn, adapt, and overcome in the face of relentless setbacks and mounting challenges. This is the American army's first major campaign against German forces and it’s a trial by fire.

Fight across 15 missions based on real battles, and tactical challenges from Operation Torch. From beach landings and stealth ops to desperate defensive actions and climactic assaults, every mission presents a distinct problem to solve, that will require the use of a specific tool to achieve victory.

Mold your army's development from inexperienced rookies to battle hardened veterans in a progression system that persists across the entire campaign. Make meaningful choices between missions, unlock upgrades, and customize your force to suit your preferred playstyle. Additional rewards await commanders willing to pursue secondary objectives and master every challenge.

Experience the campaign through the perspectives of three American soldiers whose personal stories bring the conflict to life. Witness the hardships, losses, and triumphs that transform an untested fighting force into a disciplined army capable of achieving victory against overwhelming odds.
Campaign
New narrative-driven single-player campaign DLC set during Operation Torch in North Africa
Missions drawn from real battles, events and operational problems of the campaign
A dramatic arc running from the landings, through the defeat at Kasserine, to the finale at Hill 609
Three central characters providing command and field perspective on the campaign
Missions and Tactics
Each mission built around a specific tactical problem to solve
Mission types, terrain and force composition change throughout the campaign
Each mission spotlights a unit or battlefield capability suited to that mission's challenge
Includes 15 unique missions
Progression and Player Choice
Two progression choices per mission
One or two upgrades earned per mission, with additional progression available through secondary objectives
Choices persist, letting players build the force around their preferred playstyle
Achievements
We have now implemented Steam's new Achievements Sets. Achievements will now be separated for players who own Company of Heroes 3, Final Stand, and the new Operation Torch DLC.

🗺️ MAP CHANGE
E-District Night has returned to map rotations with the following improvements to address community feedback:
Increased base exposure
Increased ambient brightness
Rebalanced color correction for a more neutral render
Decreased fog density by about 20%
Decreased fog brightness by about 40%
Doubled fog draw distance

Dev note: After hearing the feedback regarding E-District, we realized we over indexed on atmosphere and mood in an effort to please fans of the night version. This was a modified version of E-District from our Cyberpunk event and we realize that what might be acceptable and well received in Wildcard doesn’t mean it will translate directly to the core BR experience. We reevaluated our fog density and distances, tuned our color grades and struck a balance for improved visibility while still emphasizing the neon glows of the city.

There are still ways we as a team can improve and we will continue to do so over time. This includes revisiting our other maps and reevaluating atmosphere and color grades on those as well. We will be analyzing ideal fog distances to maintain gameplay visibility and start to be more consistent in our application across our maps. As new rendering features have been made available to the team, there is a natural instinct to experiment and take advantage of those features and in this case we lost sight on what matters most. Thanks for the ongoing feedback. The team is listening and eager to deliver the best looking version of Apex Legends possible.

items.text: The Spell Brigade is officially out now. We took a quick power nap and got right back into it, ready for more!

We’ve already gathered a bunch of suggestions and bug reports from everyone that played it on launch day, so a big thank you to you all for providing us with your constructive feedback🤝 The matchmaking had some issues that were quickly pointed out, so we’ve had a look and fixed some of the biggest problems already to provide you with a quick patch. You can check out the notes below:
🤝 Increased Enemy speed when Sol’phish, the Long One appears.
🤝 Increased the rate at which Enemy Health and Damage scale over time when Sol’phish, the Long One is on the battlefield, making it harder to stall the end of the Mission.
🤝 Reduced the reload speed of Revive Tokens after each Revive.
🤝 Reduced the number of Statues required to destroy for the Statue Objective.
🤝 Increased the time limit for completing the Statue objective.
🤝 Added a "Leave" button so Players can leave the Game Over menu at their own will (this is a temporary fix, we are looking into better solutions for the next update).
🤝 Fixed an issue where matchmaking status wasn't displayed correctly for clients.
🤝 Fixed an issue causing lobbies to merge unintentionally.
🤝 Fixed an issue where progress for the Amethyst Moon Mage challenge wasn't being tracked.
🤝 Fixed z-fighting on ice textures in the Frozen Ancients map for Steam Deck.
🤝 Fixed strange shadows appearing on the game over screen for Steam Deck.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the "Apply" button in the Options Menu appeared unresponsive when the menu was force-closed.
🤝 Fixed mismatched key bindings for the Quick Chat options on keyboards.
🤝 Fixed an issue where using the Quick Chat menu would shift the spectator camera's focus.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Sol’phish, the Long One wasn't counted as a completed objective.
🤝 Fixed an issue where the "Disconnected" icon appeared in the lobby when connected.
🤝 Fixed an issue where Players would respawn multiple times after dying.
🤝 Fixed an issue where choosing a Spell Augmentation incorrectly increased that Spell’s Level.
🤝 = changes inspired by community feedback

You’ve probably spotted a cheeky little countdown in the Start Menu. That means that you can expect our first real update next week, featuring some more matchmaking fixes, quality-of-life improvements and maybe even some new stuff already🤫

Again, thank you everyone! We had a good launch, and all your kind words have given us enough energy for many more updates! If you haven’t already, please leave an honest review on our store page, as it helps us out greatly.
Stay tuned, enjoy the wizarding and see you soon. We’ll get back to work now🫡
