Hello Deadsiders!
Today at 11:00AM CET / 4:00AM CDT we will release Update 1.13 (without a wipe)!

This update has one of the longest patch notes that we have posted, mainly due to the sheer amount of bug fixes and technical changes. There are some big new features as well like mini-boss encounters, squad system rework, and more that we will cover in this post. Let's begin with one of the most technically challenging feature; UAZ shooting!

As with most vehicle related features adding the ability to shoot out of a UAZ was a complex process. We originally teased it back in October, with development starting long before that. Happily we can say it will be in version 1.13, allowing you to shoot on the move with any weapon. Additionally the UAZ has 20% more durability, with all vehicles losing durability slower due to driving. Check out the vehicle improvements section in the patch notes for all the details there.

Large POIs have become a bit more dangerous in this version with the addition of a mini-boss encounter! This tough boss wears Heavy Assault armor, and won't go down quickly. This boss spawns without any marked event on the map, making these points of interest more interesting outside of an active event. Make sure to keep an eye out for this boss, it could be dangerous if you don’t!

One highly requested feature included in this version is a rework to the squad system. This new system shows the health, distance, and online status of everyone in your squad on screen. If a squad member is disconnected they remain in the squad for 10 minutes so that you don’t have to rebuild the squad again from scratch. If you want to move the on screen panel, you can by pressing . The new system also allows for a few new modkit nodes: “Is In My Squad” and “Get Squad Members”.

Speaking of the modkit, we have added the ability to use AI agents like Claude for mod development. These are powerful tools that have already made big waves in the overall gaming modding communit, so we are interested to see what our community creates with it in Deadside. For those interested, we have a guide on our wiki and Youtube.

This update does mark the end of the Halloween Event as we move closer to the new year. While you won't be able to find the seasonal items anymore, any that you already have will persist. We hope you enjoyed this year's new event content, in fact we may also have new content for the new years event, stay tuned for that.

Outside of those main features this update includes a lot lot more. Just to list off a few big ones: ragdolls are now more realistic, holes in rocks have been patched to prevent some underground building, boars howl much less often, dead body markers have a 20 minute timer and can manually be removed, and driving is more optimized. Be sure to read through the patch notes below, as this version comes with a huge amount of changes and bug fixes that would take too long to cover here. Like 1000 floating trees being fixed!
Let us know what you think about all those changes, and enjoy version 1.13!
Passengers in a UAZ can now lean out of the window and shoot any firearm

Squad System Rework: Squad list is moved from the map to a new panel which displays health, distance and online status. Disconnected members remain in the squad for 10 minutes. Panel can be moved with
Added mini-bosses at large POIs that functions as a rare encounter. The boss wears heavy assault and has a few guards
The Roaming Trader now sells blueprint fragments in three new tabs: Weapons, Clothing and Base Building. High-tier blueprints are not for sale

Dead body markers now show each of your bodies (up to 3), stay through relogs and server restarts, and show the time left before the body disappears (20 mins). +click a body marker on the map to remove it.
Less stutter when travelling across the map by vehicle, and during daytime weather changes. (Internal benchmark for you: worst frame 159 -> 63-76 ms)
Bodies now fall more naturally: limbs no longer bend at impossible angles, and arm hits no longer throw the whole body
Increased the damage of GRM-40 and Mosin grenade launcher grenades; their blast radius now matches the F-1 grenade

The Halloween event has ended: bots and loot are back to their regular tables. Halloween items you own persist

releases.displayName: Update: batting improvements, drill stats and fixes

items.text: New
Drill stats: at the end of every drill, the scoreboard now shows balls hit and your hit rate, good shots, errors, misses, your best streak and your fastest shot.
Baseball foul lines: foul lines are now drawn on the field. Hits that land outside them, or reach a wall outside them, are foul balls.
Swing timing (baseball, PC): swing early to pull the ball, late to hit to the opposite field. Mistime it too much and it goes foul.
Distance scoring (baseball and cricket, PC): every hit scores points for how far it travels, shown where the ball lands.
Celebration camera: after a long rally, the camera turns to the point's winner. At the end of a match it circles the winner.
Walk back between points: with AutoRun on, your player walks back to position for the next point instead of jumping there. Point celebrations keep playing on the way.
Changes
Cricket: deliveries are slower, giving you about a second to react.
Cricket: moving and teleporting keep you inside your crease.
Auto/manual pitch toggle: moved to T on the keyboard and R2 / RT on a controller. It was on the lob and drop-shot buttons, which switched auto pitch off mid-swing.
First person on launch: the menu now opens in first person.
Fixes
Baseball (VR): the view now stays fixed to the world when you move your head.
Baseball and cricket: the camera stays steady while the pitch comes in.
Baseball and cricket: the ball machine no longer stops pitching after a ball lands.
Baseball and cricket: hits that reach a wall on the fly now score instead of counting as out.
Drills: the last ball of a drill is now counted in your stats.
Leave a review: the button now opens the Steam review page.

This patch has had changes done to progression to open the early game up more; it is now even more rewarding, and classes level up faster. Patch 4 also adds 5 new weapons and brings our biggest balance update yet, with changes to existing weapons, attachments, and augments. Though most items are buffed, there are a few balance adjustments that we had to make after discovering bugs/issues in the system. One example being that long term we do need to make the highest difficulties more challenging. We appreciate you sticking with us and telling us what’s working and where we can do better.
5 new weapons have been added to the game, 3 returning from AFE and 2 new ones. They are being given out as mission, class and player rank rewards. For more details see the weapons section

Heat weapons are both powerful and have unlimited ammo. Outside of high skill levels and certain builds, this makes it hard for weapons with ammo to compete at higher difficulty levels where ammo is even more scarce. We want this to be a more interesting choice, so we’ve taken the following steps:
Mildly reducing the effectiveness of certain heat weapons which were a bit too powerful
Increasing the max ammo of many signature weapons
Adding new single use ammo items on extreme / insane difficulty (see notes below)
For future patches looking into a more significant refactor of how ammo is awarded in missions

Attachments, Augments, and Weapon Traits have been rebalanced. Negative modifiers have been reduced across the board and positive modifiers increased to compensate better, especially for larger negatives
Players now start with 4 / 6 backup magazines on Extreme & Insane difficulties
They are directly in your item wheel, they do not compete with other ammo items
Each refill 50% of that weapon’s max ammo
Does not work for Heat Weapons
Players now take 50% less damage when knocked down to alleviate frustrating burst damage when unable to react
Turrets no longer block projectiles when friendly fire is disabled, and no longer trigger the near-miss explosions

This is mainly to slightly balance a strong interaction with particle beam

The utility of this ability makes it a very strong choice, and we wanted to retain its power, but edge other secondary abilities to being more powerful.

Particle Beam was covering a bit too many bases which made it outshine other Hunter abilities. It has some of the highest damage output but was still good at clearing groups of enemies. This update contains new weapons and changes, and improvements to many existing weapons. Generally, we increased the ammo of signature weapons to hopefully make players not feel as starved.
More weapons have been added to the game; we will continue to add more weapons in future patches!
M41A3 Pulse Burst
Primary weapon returning from AFE, a 4-round burst
Unlocked by completing Mission 3.1 - “Bomb Squad”
N79 EVA Laser II
Sidearm returning from AFE but re-worked to use the heat system, can be held to charge up for a stronger attack, deals incendiary damage
Unlocked by completing Mission 6.1 - “Reckoning”
Thunderbolt Mk.3 Autocannon
Marauder Signature returning from AFE but re-worked to have more potent, larger explosives but at the expense of recoil - which can be mitigated with semi-auto fire or crouching
Unlocked by reaching Rank 9 on the Marauder
CMP-1 Compass Cryo Disperser
Primary weapon that deals Cryo damage, similar to the Type 200 but with lower magazine capacity and DOT duration but faster reload speeds
Unlocked by completing Mission 5.1 - “Canyon Crawlers”
M240A2 Incinerator Unit
Primary flamethrower that has a longer range and larger magazine than the Type 99, but a narrower cone of damage
Unlocked at Player Rank 20
Smart-Aim weapons rebalance
Removed damage and stopping power reduction for smart-aim weapons and increased weakpoint damage and stopping power multipliers from 0% to 50%

The weakpoint multiplier in AFE allowed the gun to still build into weakpoint damage if desired. Returning to that allows for skill expression without changing how the base gun operates. While these changes are a buff to smart-aim weapons, they should remain balanced as extra weakpoint damage still has to be built into, and the lack of it is a large enough downside itself to not need further damage reduction
Smart-Aim augments are left unaffected by this change as they tend to already outperform the L56A3 and F44AA
649 HEL Mk.II

The HEL has been updated to be able to shoot smaller, less damaging, explosions within a single heatsink, and can be charged to fire the same size of explosions as it used to. It has also been updated to be compatible with various attachments and augments that it was not before
Now uses Heatsink instead of Internal Magazine types which will give players more build options relating to heat mechanics

releases.displayName: The Biggest Update of the Year

items.text: Welcome back Marines!

Today we have the latest news on upcoming content updates for Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 coming this year and into the next with new additions including: new weapons, armor sets, maps, challenge cards, horde mode settings, a new game mode, and much more! Sit back and have a read as this week's update is the biggest one yet!

The biggest patch of the year arrives Tuesday, November 24th for all platforms! Coming in at a whopping 22 pages of patch notes, Patch #4 has had changes done to progression to open the early game up more; it is now even more rewarding to play AFE 2 as classes will now level up faster unlocking your rewards much sooner.
5 new weapons arrive with this patch including some familiar selections from AFE 1 such as the M41A3 Pulse Burst and N79 EVA Laser II.
We also made some balance changes to combat, class abilities and weapons to accommodate the new changes in this patch.
This patch also brings further performance and stability updates ensuring you have a better gaming experience.
To learn more about the new balance changes, head on over to our \[ full patch notes here ].
We're happy to announce the roadmap for the rest of 2026 and into 2027!
In the coming months starting in the holidays lock and load with new weapons, traits, holiday themed helmets, eye & hair colors, weapon & armor colorways and more!
Early 2027: a New Game Mode will be set to arrive with an expanded perk board, customized companion bot kits, horde mode enemy selection and upgraded voiceovers & cinematics!
Alien Day 2027: a new map arrives for the year's newest game mode supported by new challenge cards, new weapons & traits, armor sets, new perks and perk variants.
Summer 2027: a new map for the new game mode arrives, more weapons & traits, new perks and perk variants, new weapon and armor colorways, and more!
1st Year Anniversary 2027: new perks & variants, expanded perk board, new challenge cards, new mods, new weapons & traits, new armor & cosmetics.

notes.title: Physical copies of AFE 2 on PS5, XBOX Series X|S and both Digital & Physical for Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027
